meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 装上后,当用户第一次使用 omo 时,它会开启引导对话,依次走过六个环节:功能导览、迁移帮助、旧会话分析、价值估算、记忆记录、首次 init-deep 提案;按用户的语言回复,并随时把了解到的偏好写入记忆。
howto.when: 当新用户要求开始使用 omo 时触发;它只自动启动一次,之后可随时用 senpi --onboard 重新打开。

say.text: 我是第一次用 omo,带我入门吧。
say.note: 会启动完整的六个环节引导对话。

say.text: 我想从 Claude Code 迁移过来,能帮我看下原来的配置吗?
say.note: 会先读取现有配置,给出迁移方案,等你同意后才动手。

say.text: 你能分析一下我以前的编程会话吗?
say.note: 会先征得同意,再从中挖掘你的工作模式与常见痛点。

howto.what_en: Guides a first-time omo user through six stages: feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording, and an init-deep proposal; replies in the user's language and saves preferences to memory throughout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once and can be reopened anytime with the senpi --onboard flag.

say_en.text: I'm new here. Please onboard me on omo.
say_en.note: Starts the full six-step guided intro.

say_en.text: I'm coming from Claude Code. Can you look at my old config and migrate it?
Could you analyze my previous coding-agent sessions?
say_en.note: With your permission, it mines them for work patterns and frustrations.
